what: CHANGELOG replacement is keyed only to NEW_VERSION, so replayed old-version CHANGELOG commits are not removed
scenario_or_breakage: After a rebase/re-bump from 1.2.3 to 1.2.4, the replayed Update CHANGELOG for 1.2.3 commit remains in file content and the writer inserts 1.2.4 above it, shipping a stale changelog entry despite the plan claiming HEAD content is always correct
suggested_fix: Track the previous bump version or old changelog commit and explicitly replace/remove that generated entry, or drop the paired Update CHANGELOG commit together with the stale bump before rebase; add a multi-iteration test that asserts only the final version entry remains

what: The plan updates the markdown sub-procedure but misses ship-pr.sh, which owns current Step 10/12 rebase-rebump execution
scenario_or_breakage: Step 10/12 no longer reach the markdown procedure, so ship-pr still calls drop-bump-commit.sh without --allow-changelog-only and never re-commits CHANGELOG after apply-bump.sh, leaving the original stall/stale-changelog paths alive in CI/merge loops
suggested_fix: Add the same flag and CHANGELOG update/commit flow to run_rebase_rebump in scripts/ship-pr.sh, preferably by centralizing update-and-commit behavior in a mechanical helper reusable by implement-finalize and ship-pr

what: The implementation plan changes implement-finalize.sh from git-amend-add.sh to commit-changelog.sh but does not update the existing postbump harness stubs and failure assertions
scenario_or_breakage: make test-implement-finalize will either call a missing stub or keep asserting amend-specific failure controls, so the required regression suite can fail even if runtime code is correct
suggested_fix: Update the harness to stub commit-changelog.sh, rename STUB_AMEND_FAIL-style controls/assertions to commit semantics, and assert the helper receives --version NEW_VERSION

what: The plan adds scripts/test-commit-changelog.sh as a Makefile-only harness but omits agent-lint reachability exclusions
scenario_or_breakage: Existing Makefile-only harnesses like test-drop-bump-commit are explicitly excluded; the new harness and sibling md can be flagged as dead by agent-lint during make lint
suggested_fix: Add scripts/test-commit-changelog.sh and scripts/test-commit-changelog.md to agent-lint.toml beside the drop-bump harness exclusion, and update docs/linting.md if the harness target/shard table is documented there
